title: Keep agent guidance mirrors synchronized and restore the post-merge commit gate

outcomes.statement: CODEX.md, .cursorrules and .github/copilot-instructions.md always equal the fully layered CLAUDE.md, so every assistant reads the same governing guidance.
outcomes.demo: Run reconcile-sprint1-docs.py --check on a tree whose CLAUDE.md carries a new layered section; the mirrors reconcile to that same text and sha256 equality holds for all four files.

outcomes.statement: A commit can pass the readiness commit gate when HEAD is a merge commit.
outcomes.demo: With HEAD a two-parent merge, `work-readiness.mjs check-staged` validates against the first parent instead of failing WR_GIT_TOPOLOGY_UNSUPPORTED.

outcomes.statement: The measured Stryker ignorePatterns narrowing is committed so every run gets the deterministic parse-warning elimination.
outcomes.demo: stryker.conf.json carries the six exclusions; a cold run emits 0 generated-HTML preprocessor warnings against the recorded 170.

uncertainties.statement: Whether mirrors may track the layered CLAUDE.md given CHG-022's closed bootstrap manifest.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-022 allowed_paths excludes the three mirrors and is consumed at 21/21; the mirrors must be governed by this separate CHG.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the merge-HEAD guard is intentional or a defect.
uncertainties.resolution: work-readiness.mjs:375 refuses any merge HEAD, so the first commit after every merge is ungateable; treated as a defect.

uncertainties.statement: reconcile-sprint1-docs.py is byte-pinned by REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 in scripts/work-readiness/git.mjs; editing it silently disables overlay-layer recognition.
uncertainties.resolution: The mirror-sync child re-pins the constant to the new reconciler digest in the same commit and records the reviewer sign-off the comment requires.

partitions.title: Agent guidance mirrors track the layered CLAUDE.md
partitions.outcome: CODEX.md, .cursorrules and .github/copilot-instructions.md reconcile to the fully layered CLAUDE.md text.
partitions.demo: reconcile-sprint1-docs.py --check passes with all four files at one sha256 after a layered CLAUDE.md change.

uncertainties.statement: The reconciler byte-pin must be re-reviewed and updated with the edit.
uncertainties.resolution: Update REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 to the new digest in the same commit.

partitions.title: Staged readiness validates a merge HEAD against its first parent
partitions.outcome: Commits are possible immediately after a merge without bypassing the readiness gate.
partitions.demo: check-staged succeeds with a two-parent HEAD and still rejects an unowned staged path.

partitions.title: Commit the measured Stryker sandbox exclusions
partitions.outcome: Every Stryker run uses the six ignorePatterns and emits no generated-HTML parse warnings.
partitions.demo: A cold core run reports 0 preprocessor warnings and an unchanged 100.00/88.89 score.
